title: Admit exactly one price source, on a dated terms note, before any residual is quoted
what_and_why: every market column is blank because no price exists; the day one source is admitted, 39 differences per week become live and the leaderboard can stop being a calibration exercise
impact: highest - it converts the whole site from model output to a testable edge
effort: an owner decision plus one capture job
risk: terms and legality; a bad source poisons every residual built on it
publishes: a dated terms row in the source register, then a filled difference column
status: PROPOSED - do not implement before the decision

title: Read the remaining 13 Week-10 Game Books the way this module read one
what_and_why: one read produced 22 confirmed starters, 12 inactive entries, the venue, roof, surface, weather, officials and a designation-to-play check; thirteen more turns the availability graph from an anecdote into a dataset
risk: the extracted Not Active block may be truncated (CL-F-07) - verify the block length per club before trusting absence
publishes: availability_w10_full.csv with one row per designated player

title: Keep the Week-11 board frozen and grade it on Thursday, then never edit it
what_and_why: this is the only true out-of-sample object the project will ever have for Week 11: 13 fixtures priced two days before the first snap, with the commit hash as the registration
impact: high - it is the difference between a pre-registered test and a backtest
risk: the temptation to reconcile the numbers afterwards; the register forbids it
publishes: settlement_w11.csv next to settlement.csv, same columns

title: Fold the Week-10 close-out into the shared feed instead of leaving a 15th copy
what_and_why: the canonical feed on main is three days stale; this module holds the correct 14 rows but cannot edit another session's owned file
impact: high - every other tree inherits the fix
effort: small: one file plus the CI rebuild it already gates on
risk: touching a determinism-gated file the wrong way breaks the Pages build

title: One pre-registration register for the whole repository, keyed to commit hashes
what_and_why: three trees register strategies with three gate sets and no shared counter, so no multiplicity correction can be computed honestly
effort: medium: a CSV plus a check that every published score names a register id
risk: existing published numbers will be revealed as unregistered and must be labelled retrospective
publishes: preregistered.csv: id, rule text, window, gates, hash

title: Publish both shrink variants (k=1.0 and k=0.5) until one wins on the Week-11 slate
what_and_why: the ablation prefers k=0.5 on the same games it was chosen on; the brief's rule is to run both estimators and keep the gap column rather than pick silently
effort: small: one extra column set on the same board
risk: two lines per game invites cherry-picking after the fact unless the register freezes the comparison rule first
publishes: a gap column per fixture and a winner rule stated before Thursday

title: Ban in-sample figures from every summary page, not just the leaderboard
what_and_why: in-sample R-squared is 0.407 while the walk-forward margin forecast loses to predicting zero (MAE 11.172 vs 10.609); any page that quotes the first number without the second is misleading by construction
impact: high - it is the site's credibility
effort: small: a rendering rule plus a verifier check that each model figure carries its window
risk: several existing pages will have to be relabelled retrospective
publishes: a window badge on every model number

title: Consolidate the site trees and print one as-of stamp per dataset
what_and_why: fourteen trees answer the same brief with different data dates; this module is the fourteenth and that is a defect, not a feature
effort: large: one generator, per-tree redirects, a freshness column
risk: breaking links for readers who bookmarked a tree
publishes: one landing page, one as-of table, every tree archived read-only

title: Turn the injury capture into a scheduled job with a drift alarm
what_and_why: the report is a time series and the site holds two accidental samples of it; a Wed/Thu/Fri capture with pinned row counts would have caught the Lions blank-designation problem before a human did
effort: small: an existing workflow pattern to copy
risk: an alarm that is not loud enough becomes noise; the job must fail the build
publishes: a dated capture per club per day with a delta column

title: Score designation reliability before letting it price anything
what_and_why: the one game read here shows Questionable is not a synonym for 'out' - 5 of them started - so a fixed points penalty for a missing starter would be wrong in both directions
risk: an old published percentage is not a measurement and will be re-quoted as one
publishes: play rate per designation with a game-cluster interval

title: Add the removal-of-luck panel to the landing page, fed by this module
what_and_why: the numbers exist now: the 95 percent luck band for a 13-game run, the game-cluster bootstrap interval, the three controls, and the multiplicity question nobody has answered
effort: small once the tree is consolidated
risk: a panel with no data under it becomes decoration
publishes: luck band, bootstrap interval, control rates and the trials count

title: Leave parlays and prop combos unpriced until a joint model exists
what_and_why: the side-over joint correlation measured here is 0.354 on 13 games with an interval spanning zero, which is precisely the number a multiplied marginal would have quietly assumed
risk: publishing combos now would be arithmetic theatre
depends_on: SG-C-01 for void and push rules
publishes: nothing until a validated joint probability exists
status: PROPOSED - already the de facto rule
